summary: Versamet Royalties Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting a change of auditor. Effective May 15, 2026, KPMG resigned as auditor at the company's request, and PwC was appointed to fill the vacancy, approved by the audit committee and board. No modified opinions or reportable events were noted. This is a routine administrative change, not a special situation. As a Canadian foreign private issuer using Form 6-K, this filing is equivalent to an 8-K auditor change announcement. No deal terms or strategic event is present; the filing simply updates regulators and shareholders on the auditor transition.
